description: Focused disposable Studio runtime fixtures; no persistent profiles or real requests used by UI fixtures.

colossalColossalArmyChecks.name: Fresh Colossal odds are 1% Legendary and 3% Mythic; near-max is rarer
Select Best keeps one highest-power Colossal and fills ordinary Giant slots
Manual second Colossal rejects atomically; explicit replacement and stale protection work
Older saved multi-Colossal selections normalize without deleting or shrinking birds
Fusion cannot leave two Colossals equipped; retained size and price are unchanged
Buying a slot skips a conflicting Colossal and adds an ordinary reserve
Battle swaps wait for old Colossal to return on either side; rapid reversals reuse it
A dead retiring Colossal returns through respawn before replacement; finite lives stay spent

colossalGiantFusionChecks.name: Every rarity guarantees a Giant; inventory, stats, lineup and saves retain it
Rarity bands keep Common Giants small and quantiles ordered
Fusing Giants retains the largest input regardless of survivor order
Old profiles stay normal; invalid optional sizes reject without loading
Rejected batch does not change size or consume any input
Every catalog appearance respects the maximum body extent
Growth stays grounded, keeps small collider, and is idempotent
Battle lineup, new rig, respawn and snapshot retain Giant size

colossalFusionPriceChecks.name: Fee follows species and level; upgrades and wallet cannot change the quote
Insufficient, missing, stale and malformed quotes never spend or consume
Exact balance succeeds once; service fee is not refunded or duplicated
Batch affordability and stale last quote reject the entire transaction
Saved large Commons survive retuning; advertised range honors actual inputs

colossalMergeStandChecks.name: Exactly three become one; retained ID, investment, coins and save roundtrip
Replay and old two-ID payload cannot consume more chickens
Duplicate, foreign, malformed, mismatched species/stars/levels fail atomically
Favorites, away, defending and capped chickens are excluded
Three home reserves can merge while their squad is away
Only 3+ copies shown, extra copies remain; preview uses actual stats
Whole batch rejects shared IDs or invalid final triple without partial mutation
Sparse batches and legacy pairs rejected; paid automation stays disabled

colossalClientUI.name: Colossal inspector labels actual size and offers an explicit replacement
Dragging a second Colossal into a different slot or empty slot cannot submit
Smaller Giants can equip normally; an equipped Colossal can unequip
Desktop and compact Colossal controls fit and retain accessible target sizes

colossalFuseUI.name: Fresh fuse preview displays exact Legendary and Mythic Colossal odds
Inherited Colossal preview shows guaranteed result and fixed low-rarity size
